description: She wears an opaque cream-beige floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted paneled bodice and shaped elbow-length sleeves. Gold and brown geometric embroidery borders frame the neckline, center seams, cuffs and hem. A burgundy and gold woven sash sits at the waist with ornate round gold clasps and small dangling ornaments. A matching russet-burgundy wrap edged in gold patterns and fringe rests around her forearms and hangs at both sides. Dark brown open sandals appear beneath the skirt. Gold pendant earrings and a simple necklace accent the attire. Fabric has a textured soft sheen; exact fiber is uncertain.
